items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: We used to go over here, Fletcher Henry's big Henderson's band all the time.

ctx.x: What do you, you say you knew Frank Trumbire fairly well?

We were real good friends. George Johnson and Frank and Bob and I, and Bob Gillette and I used to go over to East Orange, and about every Wednesday or Thursday, I forgot, in the afternoon, and go horseback riding. Frank always had an Indian pinto horse in his big hat. Of course he was on full-blooded Indian, you know, so you knew that I suppose. Who's this now? Frank Trumbire. And we used to have a great time going over there and going horseback riding over there. Dick didn't get in that part of it. He was…
In New York? When you were playing at the Cinderella? Yeah.
